name: Puff Pastry "Unicorn Horns" with Deli Turkey, Mozzarella & Cranberry Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Remove pastry sheets from box and outer wrapping, then set on the counter to thaw slightly, 20-40 minutes. (The pastry is ready when it unfolds easily but is still cool to the touch.)
When the pastry is cold but pliable, preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place egg and water in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the egg wash and set aside.
Mince turkey and set aside. Place cranberry sauce in a small bowl and mash with a spoon to loosen (this will make it easier to spread without tearing the pastry).
instructions.secondary_message:
4 oz oven roasted turkey breast, sliced
½ cup cranberry sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut one sheet of puff pastry in half crosswise. Transfer both rectangles to the baking sheet and spread each with cranberry sauce, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edge. Divide minced turkey and mozzarella between the two rectangles, spreading them out over the sauce in an even layer.

Brush the border of both rectangles with egg wash. Cut the remaining sheet of puff pastry in half crosswise and use each rectangle to cover the two layered rectangles, pinching and pressing the edges to close.

With the long edge of the rectangle facing towards you, use a sharp knife to make 3 vertical cuts, portioning the pastry into 4 equal sections. Carefully cut each section in half lengthwise on an angle to create 8 triangles. Repeat with the remaining rectangle, creating a total of 16 narrow triangles.

Working one at a time, hold the bottom end of each triangle firmly, then twist the top pointed end 3-4 times, crating a spiral "horn." Space the horns out on the baking sheet, firmly pinching both ends to secure. (Don't worry if things get a little messy, they will still turn out great!)
Brush tops of the assembled pastry horns with a thin layer of egg wash.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the horns are golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 30 minutes.
To serve, transfer horns to a serving platter and enjoy!
